fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) spread the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block near-verbatim, including the full articleBody. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the site-wide RSS feed. Extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear, and upstream text values may contain double-HTML-escaped entities (e.g. literal '&#039;' instead of an apostrophe) -- passed through as-is per this portfolio's raw-passthrough convention.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (article-mode, from NewsArticle JSON-LD). May contain double-HTML-escaped entities, e.g. '&#039;' in place of an apostrophe.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary (article-mode from NewsArticle), or the raw RSS item description text (latest-mode).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date with +05:30 IST offset (article-mode).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date with +05:30 IST offset (article-mode).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline as a single Person object (raw passthrough) -- usually a desk credit like 'Business Today Desk' rather than an individual reporter.

associatedMedia.title: Associated media
associatedMedia.description: Additional media object(s) attached to the article, as emitted upstream (article-mode).

url.title: Canonical URL
url.description: Canonical article URL as emitted in the NewsArticle block (article-mode).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated topic tags, as emitted upstream (article-mode).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL with a trailing '?utm_source=rssfeed' query param (latest-mode).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: RSS pubDate string with +05:30 IST offset (latest-mode).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: RSS item guid, identical to the link value on this feed (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
